unit.why: A brief exemplary legend, quoted from an earlier book, about an anonymous pious villager whose lifelong study of tractate Hagigah escorted him to Paradise; it has no Hasidic figures.

stories.start_quote: ובא וראה מהמעשה בחסיד שהיה דר
stories.summary_en: A pious man in a small village who owned only tractate Hagigah studied it all his long life, and at his death the tractate took human form, went before him and brought him to Paradise.

quotes: והיה כל ימיו של אותו החסיד עוסק במסכת חגיגה
tags.why: Lifelong study of one tractate is the core of the tale

quotes: ולבסוף קודם מותו נתלבשה אותה המס׳

tags.why: He is brought to Gan Eden

quotes: נתלבשה אותה המס׳ בדמות אשם והלכה לפניו
tags.why: The tractate takes on a bodily form
Praises an anonymous pre-Hasidic pious man and is quoted from an earlier book
Framed with 'ובא וראה' as a lesson in the value of persistent Torah study
Embedded in a homiletic discussion of the merit of studying without full understanding
